$comment: Product metadata for listing and catalogue use. Not read by the engine.

positioning.scope: the whole of a personal life, in one book
positioning.one_line: Twelve life areas scored before a single goal is set, then annual to daily planning, health, sleep, money, people, learning and travel in the same system.

primary: People running life across four apps that do not talk to each other
New-year planners who want one book instead of five

differentiators: Wheel of Life scored across twelve areas before any goal is set
Health, sleep, food, water and movement tracked without a separate app
Money — overview, budget with totals, and savings goals
Relationship planner recording when you last actually spoke to people
Reading, learning, travel and a bucket list with first steps and dates
Life Dashboard — twelve months of habits, movement, sleep and savings on one page
41 distinct page types, the widest of any product in the collection
Four sizes, verified page and link parity

differs_from.whole_collection: FIRST PERSONAL-LIFE PRODUCT. Every other product in the catalogue is business or work-productivity facing. This is the only one covering health, relationships, family, personal finance and wellbeing. No catalogue conflict.
differs_from.013-habit-tracker: 12 is a habit system in depth. This carries a single 31-day habit grid as one section of a much wider planner.
differs_from.012-goal-achievement-planner: 11 is goal selection and review for any goal. This is the life-wide context those goals sit inside.

compatibility.print: 100% scale, no bleed required, 100–120 gsm recommended
